title: STARTDT activation followed by General Interrogation
purpose: Exercise link activation state and then enter the I-format interrogation path with a station interrogation qualifier.
expected_behavior: The peer may confirm STARTDT activation, after which it parses the I-format C_IC_NA_1 activation request with cause of transmission 6 and qualifier of interrogation 20.
constraints_preserved: IEC 60870-5-104 APCI start byte 0x68 is used for both frames.
The STARTDT U-format control field is 07 00 00 00.
The I-format frame length 0x0e equals four APCI control bytes plus the 10-byte ASDU.
TypeID 100 is C_IC_NA_1; the ASDU uses VSQ 1, cause 6, common address 1, IOA 0, and QOI 20.
All multibyte address and cause fields use ordinary low-byte-first IEC 60870 ordering.
issue_safety_notes: PK-only valid-structure seed; no vulnerability claim, malformed length, or historical payload collision is intentionally included.
